usedFor: Superchat holds customer conversations, and Shopify receives the person when “Contact Created” runs “Create Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Created” in Superchat, then “Create Customer” in Shopify
bestTemplate.why: A new chat contact becomes a Shopify customer with contact info and tags.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so a Superchat contact made from it arrives after a scheduled check.
